title: When the Tide Breaks
author: U. M. Delacroix
blurb: Ivo Okafor, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the bakery lease runs out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
